notes.notes:
An Opossum City survivor discovered a bug that caused the game to freeze while driving a car. This hot fix should squash that bug. Please report any bugs in the discussion section of the steam page.

https://steamcommunity.com/app/2743310/discussions/

notes.title: Update March 30th: Leaderboard Billboard
notes.notes:
Hey Opossum City survivors. Got the high score on our leaderboard? Now everyone will know with the implementation of our live leaderboard billboard! Top scores from steam leaderboards will show here.

Also, we have a new leaderboard for the fastest time to escape Opossum City. So get out there and get some bragging rights!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235438/c84de508f080d48f23fad9e747c1bef5cdeb237d.png[/img]

notes.title: hot fix march 25th
notes.notes: Fixed some bugs stopping achievements and leaderboard from being recorded for some missions.

notes.title: Update March 22nd: Leaderboards
notes.notes:
Introducing Steam Leaderboards! Now you can compete with players globally to climb the leaderboard. The number of times you complete a mission is now recorded on this leaderboard:
https://steamcommunity.com/stats/2743310/leaderboards/16009963

Adding Steam Leaderboards is the foundation for future features including;
[olist]
[*] Having a leaderboard visible in the game. Maybe see your name on a billboard in Opossum City
[*] Having unlockable cosmetic items like gun skins and character clothes. Each mission can have different items to unlock after completing them a specific number of times.
[*] Adding more leaderboards for other metrics; most zombies killed, fasted time to escape Opossum City, etc.
[/olist]

notes.title: Hot Fix: March 3rd: Flying Cars
notes.notes: Opossum City survivors! We have heard reports of survivors experiencing flying cars. Even getting a shortcut to Alex Manor? This update should help keep 4 wheels on the ground.

notes.title: Hot Fix: Feb 27th Achievements
notes.notes: We received reports some of the achievements were not recording correctly and that Stacey was made of glass. This hot fix should resolve these issues. Let us know in comments below!

notes.title: Update Feb 22: Achievements
notes.notes:
Fixed a bug that was stopping achievements from working. See if you can complete them all!

Also fixed a bug preventing B.E.R.T. (Bio Engineered Recovery and Termination) from spawning. Be careful out there on the streets of Opossum City!

notes.title: Update Feb 15th: Magnum
notes.notes:
Alright you Primitive Screwheads, listen up! You see this? This... is my BOOMSTICK!

Welcome back Opossum City survivors. We are excited to introduce you to Opossum City's second weapon, the 500 magnum. Base damage is 500 rounds, penetrates through anything, and has a capacity of 5 rounds. Make them count! Full list of changes below:

[olist]
[*] 500 magnum
[*] lowered health and damage of fast zombie
[*] increased damage and lowered speed of tank zombie
[*] increased ammo spawns
[*] introduced inventory rotation controls
[*] introduced drop item controls
[*] increased car health
[/olist]

Happy hunting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235438/86910ac29319eb40c682edd3a85cd6aeb137796d.png[/img]

notes.title: Update Feb 7th: V Day
notes.notes:
Happy Valentine's day! The zombies choo choose you! All the ammo boxes have been replaced with candy hearts. Can you collect them all? Also added instructional messages to help guide the player. This is part of a bigger objective update coming soon.

notes.title: Update Jan 10th: Helicopter
notes.notes:
Been hearing reports from survivors they are having difficulty piloting the helicopter. I have made the following changes;
[olist]
[*] added audio feedback to how strong the trust is. the pitch of the motor will change with thrust
[*] added visual feedback to how strong the trust is. There is a fan icon to show how strong the thrust is
[*] limited the max level of the thrust
[*] removed negative thrust
[*] reduced the sensitivity of the tilt
[/olist]

Please let me know what you think about the helicopter (or anything else) in the discussion section!
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2743310/discussions/

Happy hunting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235438/0c057198135bad18b2a80508e4e5b81dfc24c19b.png[/img]

notes.title: update Jan 4th: Graphics
notes.notes:
Hi zombie hunters/Opossum City survivors! I really appreciate your feedback. I reduced the bloom and increased ammo. I have noted the other feedback and they are part of the roadmap. This is a passion project for me and I am committed to making this the ultimate multiplayer nostalgic zombie experience. Also, I was watching Resident Evil Apocalypse (for the 100th time) and what I noticed was smokey mist everywhere. It's like they must have set off smoke grenades everywhere on set. Also a lot of police cars. So I added these things to Opossum City. Let me know what you think in the discussion board!
https://steamcommunity.com/app/2743310/discussions/

- increased ammo from ammo boxes
- reduced bloom
- added mist
- added police car

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45235438/c3cd7cb41117a309b6af99f21f4f02f58d7db1f6.png[/img]
